title.en: Elon Musk's Tesla delivers 486,532 cars. What will October 21 reveal?
title.zh: 马斯克的特斯拉交付486,532辆车，10月21日还会揭晓什么？

summary.en: Tesla reports 486,532 Q3 deliveries, down about 2.13% from a year earlier, while storage deployments rise to 13.7 GWh. Quarterly financial results are scheduled for October 21; operating volumes alone do not establish profit.
summary.zh: 特斯拉公布第三季度交付486,532辆车，同比减少约2.13%；储能部署则增至13.7 GWh。季度财报定于10月21日发布，交付与部署数量本身不能证明盈利。

title.en: Taylor Swift takes three of Britain's top five. What do the numbers prove?
title.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特占据英国单曲前五中的三席，这些数字证明了什么？

summary.en: Official Charts places Patient Zero at No.1, Cleveland at No.3 and Babylon at No.4 as The Life Of A Showgirl returns to the UK albums summit. The chart double and three top-five places are rankings, not a measure of income or musical quality.
summary.zh: 英国Official Charts列Patient Zero第一、Cleveland第三、Babylon第四，The Life Of A Showgirl也重返专辑榜首。双榜冠军与单曲前五的三席，是榜单名次，不是收入或音乐质量的度量。
